info.description: REST API for sending and receiving SMS messages via a USB GSM modem.
info.title: SMS Gateway API

get.description: Returns API keys for the authenticated user, newest first. Admins see all keys.

parameters.description: Maximum keys to return (max 500). Omit to return all.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Keys to skip. Only applied together with limit.
parameters.name: offset

200.description: Total matching keys is returned in the X-Total-Count header

post.description: Generates a new API key for the authenticated user with an optional label.

delete.description: Deactivates an API key by its unique identifier. Non-admins can only deactivate their own keys.
Permanently deletes an API key by its unique identifier. Non-admins can only delete their own keys.

post.description: Allows an authenticated user to change their password by providing the current and new passwords. Every existing token is revoked; the response carries a new one for the caller.
Authenticates a user with username and password, returning a JWT token.
Revokes every token issued to the authenticated user, logging them out on all devices.

get.description: Returns saved contact names ordered by name.

parameters.description: Only contacts whose name or number contains this text
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Maximum contacts to return (max 500). Omit to return all.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Contacts to skip. Only applied together with limit.
parameters.name: offset

200.description: Total matching contacts is returned in the X-Total-Count header

put.description: Sets the display name for a phone number, creating the contact if needed.

delete.description: Removes the saved name for a phone number. Messages are not affected.

get.description: Checks database connectivity and modem status, returning the overall system health.

post.description: Sends a raw AT command to the GSM modem and returns the response. Requires admin privileges.

409.description: Dangerous or unrecognised command sent without confirm

get.description: Returns documentation for common AT commands, with the risk of running each, and the command names the modem reports through AT+CLAC (null when unsupported). Requires admin privileges.

Returns the line provider and network, the SIM phone number, ICCID and IMSI, and the modem IMEI, manufacturer, model and firmware. A field is empty when the modem or SIM cannot report it; many SIMs do not store their phone number. Requires admin privileges.
Returns the carrier setup profiles, ordered by name. Requires admin privileges.

post.description: Creates a carrier setup profile: ordered steps of AT commands, each with an optional case-insensitive regular expression its response must match. Requires admin privileges.

get.description: Returns a carrier setup profile by ID. Requires admin privileges.

put.description: Replaces a carrier setup profile's name, description, notes and steps. Requires admin privileges.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a carrier setup profile. Requires admin privileges.

get.description: Returns the GSM modem signal strength and quality assessment.
Checks whether the GSM modem is responsive and returns its current status.
Returns inbound and outbound messages grouped by phone number, most recent activity first. Each entry carries the latest message and message/unread counts.

parameters.description: Only conversations with a message whose number or body contains this text
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Maximum conversations to return (max 500). Omit to return all.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Conversations to skip. Only applied together with limit.
parameters.name: offset

200.description: Total matching conversations is returned in the X-Total-Count header

delete.description: Deletes every inbound and outbound message for the phone number.

get.description: Returns inbound and outbound messages for one phone number, newest first. Page backwards by passing the oldest received message's id as before_id.

parameters.description: Maximum messages to return (max 500). Omit to return all.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Only return messages older than this message
parameters.name: before_id

200.description: Total messages in the conversation is returned in the X-Total-Count header

put.description: Marks every unread inbound message from the phone number as read.

get.description: Returns inbound SMS messages. Use status=received for unread only (default), status=read for read messages, or all=true for everything.

parameters.description: Set to true to return all inbound messages regardless of status
parameters.name: all

parameters.description: Maximum messages to return (max 500). Omit to return all.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Messages to skip. Only applied together with limit.
parameters.name: offset

200.description: Total matching messages is returned in the X-Total-Count header

get.description: Returns outbound SMS messages, newest first.

parameters.description: Maximum messages to return (max 500). Omit to return all.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Messages to skip. Only applied together with limit.
parameters.name: offset

200.description: Total matching messages is returned in the X-Total-Count header

post.description: Sends an SMS message to the specified phone number via the GSM modem.

get.description: Returns message counts aggregated by direction and status. Lets clients show accurate totals without downloading every message.
Returns a single SMS message by its unique identifier.

delete.description: Deletes a single SMS message by its unique identifier.

put.description: Marks an inbound message as read, changing its status from "received" to "read".
Marks an inbound message as unread, changing its status from "read" back to "received".

get.description: Returns user accounts, newest first. Requires admin privileges.

parameters.description: Maximum users to return (max 500). Omit to return all.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Users to skip. Only applied together with limit.
parameters.name: offset

200.description: Total users is returned in the X-Total-Count header

post.description: Creates a new user account with the specified username, password, and admin status. Requires admin privileges.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a non-admin user account and its API keys. Messages sent with those keys are kept. Administrator accounts cannot be deleted. Requires admin privileges.

get.description: Returns registered webhooks, newest first. Requires admin privileges.

parameters.description: Maximum webhooks to return (max 500). Omit to return all.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Webhooks to skip. Only applied together with limit.
parameters.name: offset

200.description: Total webhooks is returned in the X-Total-Count header

post.description: Registers a webhook notified on the selected message events. Leave secret empty to have one generated. Requires admin privileges.

put.description: Replaces a webhook's name, URL and events. An empty secret keeps the current one and an omitted is_active keeps the current state. Requires admin privileges.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a webhook. Requires admin privileges.

supported.description:
Supported lists the command names the modem reported through AT+CLAC,
or is null when the modem does not support that query.

key.description: Key is the plaintext key, set only in the response that creates it.

confirm.description: Confirm must be true to run a dangerous or unrecognised command.

title.description: Title names the recognised command, when there is one.

contact_name.description: ContactName is the saved name for the number, empty when there is none.

unread_count.description: UnreadCount is the number of inbound messages still in "received" status.

by_status.description:
ByStatus is keyed "<direction>.<status>", e.g. "outbound.sent", so clients
can read counts this struct does not name explicitly.

network.description: Network is the operator the modem is registered on, e.g. "T-Mobile".

provider.description: Provider is the service provider name stored on the SIM, e.g. "Tello".

expect.description:
Expect is an optional case-insensitive regular expression the response
must match for the command to count as passed.

to.description:
To is an international number with + and country code (spaces, dashes,
dots and parentheses are ignored) or a 3-6 digit short code.

name.description:
Name is the command as written after "AT": "+CSQ", "&F", "I", or ""
for the bare AT attention command.

risk.description:
Risk applies to the execute and set forms. Read and test forms never
change anything and are always safe.

x-enum-comments.FormSet: AT+CMD=<args>, or ATE0 for basic commands

x-enum-descriptions: AT+CMD=<args>, or ATE0 for basic commands

BearerAuth.description: JWT token with Bearer prefix (e.g. "Bearer eyJhbG...")
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
